newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Quiksilver raised to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Quiksilver raised to buy.

text.p: Hambrecht & Quist analyst Shelly Hale Young said she raised her rating on shares of apparel maker Quiksilver Inc to buy from hold after the company announced last week it increased its domestic and European fall orders by 30 percent over the year ago-period.
-- said orders for young men's apparel, which is 70 percent of the company's total sales, are up over 25 percent.

-- raised her November 1997 fiscal year EPS estimate to $1.82/shr on sales of $228 million from $1.77/shr on sales of $222 million. She raised fiscal '98 to $2.17/shr on sales of $261 million from $2.06/shr on sales of $251 million.
